title: Self-Archival Sprint Notes — Ops
body:
Purpose: lightweight, searchable stash of short evidence + talking points to bring into 1:1s and quarterly calibration. Not polished — just what I can throw down during standup or on the train.

High-level focus for the sprint (2/10–3/5):
- Reduce time-to-fulfill simple headcount requests by 20% — aim: streamline approvals + template updates.
- Synthesize two case studies for internal pitch: onboarding automation & new manager ramp program.
- Personal craft: iterate on my coaching stories (3 concise impact narratives).

Concrete wins / evidence snippets:
- Req pipeline: cut manual approval follow-ups from average 4 days -> 1.8 days on four recent reqs (HR-987 ticket thread). Screenshots in the ticket show updated checklist and auto-reminder snippet.
- New-manager checklist pilot: ran two runs with Eng Platform; post-pilot NPS (small sample) = 8.2/10, qualitative: "made ramp predictable". Notes attached in Confluence draft.
- Cross-team: co-led sync with Recruiting and Finance to unblock offer letter timing; saved an estimated 3 business days on an offer for Senior SWE (Marcus Li comment in slack thread).

Impact narratives (3 short versions to use in manager convo):
- 30s (elevator): "I reduced the average approval friction on reqs by automating follow-ups and cleaning the checklist, which shortened time-to-offer and reduced recruiter context-switching."
- 90s (story): problem -> action -> result. Problem: slow approvals causing candidate drop-off. Action: introduced two lightweight automations + updated approver guide + monthly SLA review. Result: 40% drop in time-to-accept in pilot roles.
- Long (for calibration/email): include metrics and links, tie to hiring predictability and DEI gating.

Evidence to surface in 1:1 (ordered):
1) HR-987 ticket timeline + screenshots (linked).
2) Pilot feedback sheet (Confluence page id above).
3) Slack snippet where hiring manager praised the checklist.

Asks / manager prep items:
- Ask for time: 30–45 min to run through the two case studies next Tuesday. Goal: align on the delivery artifact for leadership review.
- Ask for rubric input: what are the 2 most persuasive metrics for show-and-tell (time-to-offer vs hiring yield vs quality-of-hire)?
- Career ask: advise on whether my next stretch should be a cross-functional program manager vs deeper people analytics ownership.

Signals / metrics I want to track next sprint:
- Median time from req opened -> offer extended (target: < 14 days).
- Reqs with >1 approver flagged and fixed (reduce to 10% of reqs).
- Manager satisfaction (post-checklist NPS target: 8+/10).

Risks / blockers:
- Recruiting workload spike could hide improvements; need to control for volume when comparing metrics.
- Finance integrations require a small engineering change — ETA uncertain.

Open questions / hypotheses to test:
- Hypothesis: 1 automated reminder + a short approver guide will reduce approval lag more than training sessions. Test by AB-ing on next 20 reqs.
- Question: Would packaging the checklist as a short Loom (<4 min) increase adoption more than doc edits? Quick experiment: record and A/B share in next hiring cohort.

Micro tasks / TODO (next 2 weeks):
- Finalize draft case study 1 (onboarding automation) — add metric table and pull quotes (Due: 2026-03-10).
- Run AB experiment: automated reminder vs no reminder on 20 reqs (start: 2026-03-08).
- Sync w/ Finance on API timeline (Marcus) and add dependency to HR-987.

Feedback I want from manager in the 1:1:
- Is the framing of the case studies compelling for a VP audience?
- Which metric would you want on a one-slide executive summary?
- How do you see the career ladder aligning with program vs IC path for the next 12 months?

Notes-to-self (scratch):
- Keep stories concise; pick 1 hero metric + 1 human quote.
- Archive working drafts into Confluence once manager signals 'go' — avoid cluttering Drive.
- Capture the specific pull-quote from the hiring manager: ask them for permission to use it.

Quick links to copy into 1:1 agenda:
- HR ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HR-987
- Draft case study page: confluence:people-ops/q1-career-framework (draft)
- Slack thread: https://app.slack.com/client/TXXXXX/CYYYYY/thread/ops-archive

Version log (manual):
- 2026-02-10: initial scratch notes from standups + pilot feedback.
- 2026-02-22: added metric snapshots and links after pilot review.
- 2026-03-05: polished asks and compiled 3 impact narratives for manager prep.

Bottom line for manager: I have measurable short-term wins and a clear plan to scale them; I need directional feedback on metric prioritization and alignment for an exec-ready artifact.

-- end of scratch --
